features.name: Project scaffold and stack setup
acceptance_criteria: Monorepo structure with pnpm workspaces defined
Backend Fastify server scaffolded with health check
Frontend Next.js app scaffolded with basic layout
Database connection with Prisma and initial migration
Docker Compose for local PostgreSQL + Redis
All builds and type checks pass
features.evidence: pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm lint all pass clean. Next.js 16.2.6, Fastify 5.8.5, Prisma 7.8.0, Tailwind 4.3.0, Auth.js 5 beta.31.

features.name: Multi-tenancy core architecture
acceptance_criteria: Tenant isolation strategy implemented (schema-per-tenant or RLS)
features.evidence: Schema-per-tenant with PrismaPg adapter. Tenant middleware resolves from subdomain/x-tenant-id header. Provisioning creates schema + tables via raw SQL. Tenant-scoped product endpoint at /api/v1/tenants/me/products.

features.name: Authentication and authorization
acceptance_criteria: Role-based access control (platform admin, merchant admin, customer)
features.evidence: Auth.js v5 credentials provider with bcrypt hashing. JWT strategy with role in token. Fastify JWT plugin for API auth. RBAC middleware with requireRole(). Login and register pages in Next.js.

features.name: Product catalog and inventory
features.evidence: Products API with full CRUD, search, filter, pagination. Categories API with tenant scoping. Merchant dashboard with sidebar auth guard. Dashboard pages: products list, new product form, category list with inline add. Typecheck, test, lint, build all pass.

features.name: Shopping cart and checkout
features.evidence: Cart API with GET, POST add item, PATCH quantity, DELETE item, DELETE clear. Order API with POST create from cart (transactional stock decrement), GET list with role-based filtering, GET detail, PATCH status. Auth plugin updated to read Auth.js session cookie for cross-origin auth. Cart UI page with quantity controls, remove, clear, checkout. Merchant orders page with status update dropdown.
